sections.heading: Business
sections.markdown: Energy / Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing · Indonesia. PT AKR Corporindo Tbk, a logistics and supply chain company, engages in distribution and trading of petroleum and basic chemical products in Indonesia. It operates through four segments: Trading and Distribution, Logistics Services, Manufacturing, and Industrial Estate and related utility services.
